title: Add exception / Remove user picker: refused send shows 'Loading' forever, Failed page has no Retry
trigger: open_add_special or search_add_special when fetch_supergroup_members / refresh_supergroup_members returns Err (page entry removed), or the first page fails with an error answer
effect: None maps to the Loading message; Failed prints the reason with no Retry button, so the person must close and reopen the picker
fix: Same Failed(reason) record for a refused send, plus a Retry button on the Failed arm (as the promote picker has)

title: Promote picker: a refused re-search wipes the shown page and leaves Loading forever
trigger: In Promote, press Search (same filter as the page shown, e.g. Recent with empty text, or Search with another query) while the driver refuses the send
effect: refresh_supergroup_members already removed the cached (chat, filter) page and its ask; searched is kept (asked is false) so promote_dialog_panel finds no page for the old text and draws 'Loading members' (the Failed arm and its Retry are never reached)
fix: Do not remove the page before the send succeeds (or restore it on Err); make a refused send a Failed stage

title: Link check whose send is refused leaves the link line on 'Checking...' with nobody to answer
trigger: Type a free-looking public link while check_group_username returns Err (chats path inactive / sender closed); check_group_link drops the error with let _
effect: The driver records Checking only after a successful send, so no verdict and no Failed ever arrive: status() stays Pending ('Checking link...'), Save is refused with the same line, until the person types another character
fix: On a refused send record UsernameCheck::Failed for that text (shows CheckFailed and Save retries it)

title: Private Type box: a failed invite-links fetch (or no primary link) is drawn as 'Loading' forever
trigger: Open the Type box of a private chat while getChatInviteLinks fails or its send is refused (open_group_type_box ignores the Err); chat_primary_invite_link maps Failed, Loading and 'Loaded without a primary link' all to None
effect: The permanent-link block shows 'Loading...' with no Retry; the Copy/Share/Revoke actions never appear until the box is reopened
fix: Match InviteLinkFetch in the block: Failed shows the reason with Retry, Loaded without a primary link says so

title: Quick replies watch poll never ends when the shortcut id never resolves, and runs while locked
trigger: In Quick Replies add a new shortcut name, type a message and Add; the server refuses (or never reports the shortcut). Leave the box open, or lock the app.
effect: quick_replies_pump returns false at `let Some(shortcut_id) = resolved else { return false }`, so the 200 ms watch task loops until the box is closed, also behind the lock screen (no refused_while_locked check). Wasted wakeups; no redraw.
fix: Watch stage in the dialog (Idle/Waiting{since}) that ends on settle or refusal; or stop the poll when the save is answered with no shortcut and when locked

title: Quick reply save answer matched by the session-wide error, not by the request held in TextSave::Sending
trigger: Add a message to a shortcut while an unrelated quick-reply error (failed delete, failed shortcuts load) is showing; or the save request is dropped with the connection.
effect: settle_quick_reply_save reads `settings.quick_replies.error.is_some()` for 'refused': a save that succeeded puts its text back in the field (resubmit duplicates the message); a request that left flight with no answer counts as accepted and the text is lost. The RequestId in TextSave::Sending is only checked for 'still in flight'.
fix: Answer keyed by the RequestId in the stage (an Answered/Refused(reason) outcome per request, like SaveWatch), not a shared error slot; pane.error and session error folded into one

title: LiveJoin::Joining never ends when the getGroupCall step fails or the stream is refused after the send
trigger: Open a live story while getGroupCall fails (offline, flood wait) or the stream is refused in a member chat (maybe_join_live_story drops pending_live_story_join with no tracker and no UI signal)
effect: The viewer shows the opening spinner for ever: join_live_story returned Ok so LiveJoin::Joining(target) is set, no story_stream exists so join_failed() is false (no Retry overlay), check_live_story_ended does nothing without a call, and sync_live_story only starts a join from Idle. Only closing the viewer or stepping away clears it.
fix: LiveJoin::Joining { target, request: RequestId }: when that request is gone with no tracker (or the join is refused) move to Refused so the Join live button shows

title: open_story swallows a failed getStory send; the pending open then waits forever
trigger: Press a story link, reply header or repost label while the chats path is inactive or the send fails. get_story_now clears the story's retry clock first (connect/stories/mod.rs:212-221) and returns Err; open_story drops it with `let _ =`.
effect: The story stays Loading with no request out and no retry clock, so `failed` is never true and resolve_pending_story_open never leaves Loading. Nothing resends. The press does nothing, and for a repost press (if_gone set) story_playback_paused holds the open viewer paused until the user steps or closes.
fix: On Err from get_story/get_story_now, drop the pending open and post the story-load-failed note (or hold the RequestId in the Waiting stage and resolve it on the error answer)

title: take_turn spends a new-person slot and a chat slot before the send; nothing gives them back when the send is refused or fails
trigger: Agent sends a first message to a person who never wrote; admit() passes take_turn, then still_allowed() fails (access went off, connection gone) or TDLib refuses the send; repeat 5 times
effect: The 5-per-day new-conversation cap is used up by sends that never went out; later real first messages are refused with 'at most 5 new conversations a day' until 24h pass
fix: A Turn guard returned by take_turn that books new_peers/next_in_chat only on commit() after the send and releases on drop

title: BoostWork stages hold no RequestId; boost answers and errors matched by purpose + chat id, and the error arm resets any phase
trigger: Open the boost box for chat C, press Boost (Slots, request A), close the box, reopen C and press Boost again (request_chat_boost adopts A by has_purpose_for_chat, or sends B), or reassign while an older boostChat for C is still out; a stale GetBoostSlotsForBoost/BoostChat error or boostChat answer then lands.
effect: The box drops to Main (error.rs sets phase=Main and a 'Could not boost' note even when the box is in Reassign or Notice, or working on a newer request) or shows a 'reassigned' note for the wrong request; the later real answer finds a different phase and is ignored, so the click looks like it did nothing.
fix: Carry the RequestId in BoostWork::Slots and BoostWork::Boosting and apply an answer or error only when it equals the id held in the phase (state/domains/groups/apply.rs:278-322, error.rs:604-617, connect/groups/boosts.rs:request_chat_boost)

title: A failed send of the speaker request is stored as 'no speaker link' for the whole call
trigger: Manager of a video chat opens Share Invite Link; the listener request goes out, the speaker request send_json fails (admin.rs request_video_chat_share_links)
effect: ConnectDriver calls share_links.failed(true), which sets speaker = Got(""); plan() only asks when speaker == Idle, so the speaker link is never asked for again and the box offers only the listener link until the call ends or the link is revoked
fix: Call unsent(true) for a send error (back to Idle); keep failed() for a server answer; or ShareLink::Failed so a retry is still sent

title: A file kept as a file (keep_as_file) flips the whole tray to send-without-compression for the next drop
trigger: Drop a very wide or narrow image (media_dimensions_valid false) or an animated webp so the media check calls keep_as_file (kind Document, FileOnly), leave a normal photo in the tray, then drop or pick another normal photo
effect: append_dropped_files computes as_files = any(kind==Document && media_kind_for(path).is_some()); the FileOnly attachment satisfies it, so the new photo is added as a Document (sent uncompressed) while the 'Send without compression' checkbox still shows unchecked (it requires all attachments Document)
fix: A tray-level SendMode enum {Compressed, AsFiles} stored with the tray (or at least skip file_only() attachments when inferring the mode)

title: A Tdlib error in the middle of a chat marks the whole chat failed after part of it was already written
trigger: a file call (getFile/downloadFile) times out or a name lookup errors in pass two, after earlier messages were pushed to result.json and flushed as HTML pages
effect: row says 'No messages' and failed_chats+1 while result.json holds a partial messages list and messages1..N html exist; summary and files disagree
fix: a per-chat outcome enum (Exported{messages}/Partial{messages,reason}/Failed) written to the row and summary; a file-call timeout becomes Skip::Unavailable instead of aborting the chat

title: A handler read that dies leaves the answer stale, so state() re-spawns a read on every draw
trigger: The settings page draws while the xdg-mime/registry read panics or the thread cannot spawn (settle(generation, None))
effect: settle puts the old answer back as Known(last) with its old `at` (or Empty with no answer); lookup() calls it stale again and start_refresh spawns another thread on each render, and each death wakes the watcher for another redraw
fix: Add a Stage::Failed{last, retry_after} (or stamp `at` on a failed settle) so a dead read is not re-sent from render
